location.zh: 楓灣語言學院，學生餐廳

goal.en: Order a safe lunch. You're allergic to peanuts.
goal.zh: 點一份安全的午餐。你對花生過敏。

background: busy school cafeteria with a long serving counter, steaming metal food trays behind glass, stacks of plastic lunch trays, round tables with chairs, bright noon light from tall windows

intro.en: It's lunchtime. Leo is already in line with a tray.
intro.zh: 午餐時間到了。里歐已經端著餐盤在排隊。

intro.en: I'm getting the noodles. They look amazing!
intro.zh: 我要點麵，看起來超好吃！

lines.en: Next! What can I get you, hon?
lines.zh: 下一位！要吃什麼呢，親愛的？

choices.tip: What's in...? 是問食材的最簡單說法。有過敏的人點餐前一定要先問。

choices.en: This one has put what inside?

lines.en: Put what... where? Sorry, hon, the line is long.
lines.zh: 放什麼……放哪裡？抱歉，親愛的，後面很多人在排。

story.en: Martha can't understand you, and the line behind you grows longer. Someone sighs loudly.
story.zh: 瑪莎聽不懂你在問什麼，後面的隊伍越排越長，有人大聲嘆了口氣。

fail.why: 「這個裡面放了什麼」逐字翻成英文會很混亂。問食材直接說 What's in the noodles? 或 What's in this?。

choices.en: Same as my friend. Anything is OK.
choices.zh: 跟我朋友一樣，什麼都可以。

lines.en: Wait, Kai! Isn't that peanut sauce on your plate?
lines.zh: 等等，凱！你盤子上那不是花生醬汁嗎？

story.en: Leo saves you just in time and takes the extra plate. Your lunch is a bag of chips from the vending machine.
story.zh: 里歐及時救了你，把多的那盤接過去。你的午餐變成販賣機的一包洋芋片。

fail.why: 「隨便、都可以」在台灣是客氣，但有過敏時很危險。國外點餐要主動說出需求，先問 What's in the noodles?。

lines.en: Noodles, chicken, and our famous peanut sauce.
lines.zh: 麵、雞肉，還有我們招牌的花生醬汁。

choices.en: Oh no. I'm allergic to peanuts.
choices.tip: be allergic to + 東西，表示對某物過敏。allergic 是形容詞，前面要有 be 動詞。

lines.zh: 你是……花生？那就多加花生？

story.en: Martha reaches for the peanut jar. Leo jumps in to explain, and you're saved by your friend.
story.zh: 瑪莎伸手去拿花生罐。里歐趕緊幫你解釋，朋友救了你一命。

fail.why: allergy 是名詞，不能直接當動詞用。要說 I'm allergic to peanuts. 或 I have a peanut allergy.。

choices.en: Peanuts? Sorry, my body can't eat.
choices.zh: 花生？抱歉，我的身體不能吃。

lines.en: Your body can't eat? Are you feeling sick, hon?
lines.zh: 你的身體不能吃？親愛的，你人不舒服嗎？

story.en: Martha sends you to the school nurse. You spend lunchtime explaining that you are not sick.
story.zh: 瑪莎把你送去保健室。你整個午休都在解釋自己沒有生病。

fail.why: 「我的身體不能吃」直譯會讓人以為你生病了。過敏要說清楚：I'm allergic to peanuts.。

lines.en: Good thing you told me! How about a beef burger?
lines.zh: 還好你有說！那來個牛肉漢堡怎麼樣？

choices.en: Hmm. Is there a vegetarian option?
choices.tip: option 是「選項」。Is there a vegetarian option? 比 Do you have vegetable food? 自然得多。

choices.en: I eat vegetable. Any vegetable food?
choices.zh: 我吃菜。有蔬菜的食物嗎？

lines.en: Vegetable food? Um, we have a side salad.
lines.zh: 蔬菜食物？嗯，我們有小份沙拉。

story.en: You get three lettuce leaves and one tomato. You're hungry again by two o'clock.
story.zh: 你拿到三片生菜和一顆番茄。不到兩點，肚子又餓了。

fail.why: 「吃素、素食」不是 eat vegetable 或 vegetable food。英文說 vegetarian，問餐點時說 Is there a vegetarian option?。

choices.en: Ew, a beef burger? No way.

lines.en: "Ew"? I made those burgers myself this morning.
lines.zh: 「噁」？那些漢堡可是我今天早上親手做的。

story.en: Martha serves you very slowly for the rest of the week. The line behind you does not like you either.
story.zh: 這整個星期，瑪莎打菜給你都特別慢。後面排隊的人也不太喜歡你。

fail.why: Ew 和 No way 對做菜的人很傷人。不想吃時客氣地問別的選擇：Hmm. Is there a vegetarian option?。

lines.en: Sure! We have a veggie curry. No peanuts at all.
lines.zh: 有啊！我們有蔬菜咖哩，完全沒有花生。

choices.en: Perfect! I'll have the curry, please.
choices.tip: I'll have... 是點餐最常用的句型，比 I want... 更禮貌自然。

choices.en: Yes! I'd like have that, please.

lines.en: Like half? Half a curry, then?
lines.zh: 要一半？那就給你半份咖哩囉？

story.en: Martha gives you half a bowl of curry. Leo shares some of his noodles, but you can't eat them.
story.zh: 瑪莎給你半碗咖哩。里歐想分你一些麵，但你偏偏不能吃。

fail.why: I'd like 後面接動詞要加 to：I'd like to have that.。漏掉 to，have 很容易被聽成 half。最簡單的說法是 I'll have that, please.。

choices.en: Whatever. I'll just eat that, then.
choices.zh: 隨便啦，那我就吃那個吧。

story.en: Martha scoops the curry without a word. It feels a little colder than everyone else's.
story.zh: 瑪莎一句話也沒說就盛了咖哩。不知道為什麼，你的那份好像比別人的冷一點。

fail.why: Whatever 在英文聽起來很不耐煩，像在說「我無所謂、懶得理你」。對方幫你找到餐點，要說 Perfect. I'll have that, please.。

lines.en: One veggie curry, extra rice. Enjoy, hon!
lines.zh: 一份蔬菜咖哩，多加飯。好好吃喔，親愛的！

lines.en: Nice! That looks even better than my noodles.
lines.zh: 不錯喔！看起來比我的麵還好吃。

story.en: You and Leo find a table by the window. The curry is warm, and there's not a single peanut in sight.
story.zh: 你和里歐在窗邊找到位子。咖哩熱騰騰的，一顆花生都沒有。

notes.explain: 問食材的最簡單說法。有過敏或飲食限制時，點餐前一定要先問。

example.en: Excuse me, what's in this sandwich?
example.zh: 不好意思，這個三明治裡面有什麼？

notes.explain: allergic 是形容詞，要用 be allergic to + 名詞。allergy 是名詞，可以說 I have a peanut allergy.。

example.en: I'm allergic to shrimp and cats.

notes.explain: vegetarian 是不吃肉，但可能吃蛋奶；vegan 是全素，連蛋、奶、蜂蜜都不吃。點餐時說清楚比較保險。

example.en: Do you have any vegan options?

notes.explain: I'll have... 是點餐最常用的句型。I'd like... 也可以，但後面接動詞要加 to。

example.en: I'll have the chicken salad, please.

notes.explain: 中文說「隨便」常是客氣，但英文的 Whatever 聽起來很不耐煩、不在乎。想表示都可以，改說 Either is fine. 或 I'm OK with anything.。

example.en: Pizza or pasta? Either is fine with me!
example.zh: 披薩還是義大利麵？我都可以！
